# Grug training oracle

This fixture was generated by Marin's Levanter-based Grug oracle. It lets
MarinSkyRL compare PyTorch routing, outputs, gradients, query bias, and one SGD
update without installing JAX or Levanter.

Provenance:

- Marin commit: `6195867835efa48c03b739a3aa67ef06cea78f16`
- Producer: `tests/cluster/vllm/grug_training_oracle.py`
- Producer SHA-256: `a8c6fd22129fc567baa43d18529f37e15901a6318aebe3dbe53e5370890f3d7a`
- Producer PR: <https://github.com/marin-community/marin/pull/7420>
- Generated with the CPU JAX backend; total fixture payload: 157,173 bytes

Regenerate from that Marin commit with:

```bash
PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu uv run python \
  tests/cluster/vllm/grug_training_oracle.py \
  --output /tmp/grug-training-oracle
```

The fixture intentionally freezes Levanter behavior at the producing commit.
The recurring MarinSkyRL test detects PyTorch drift from this snapshot, but it
cannot detect later Levanter drift until the fixture is regenerated and reviewed.
